summary: OMS Energy Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its fiscal year 2026 financial results and the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F. The release details revenues of $155.9M, operating profit of $34.9M, and record operating cash flow of $54.1M. It also describes recent business highlights, including call-off orders from Saudi Aramco and new orders from operators in several countries. The filing is a routine earnings announcement and does not involve or disclose any special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. No deal terms are present.
